description: One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources. Optionally pass the genotype read at that position (e.g. from a raw DNA file) to get how many copies of the variant allele it holds. That count is not a phenotype, metabolizer or risk call.

genotype.description: Optional. The genotype at this position, e.g. AG, A/G, or one letter on X, Y or MT. Not stored.

name: lookup_variant
title: Look up a variant
